{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-run the within-segment difference computation and explicitly print each value

# Within-segment conversion rate differences
conv_diff = conv_by_seg.loc['email'] - conv_by_seg.loc['paid_search']
print("Within-segment conversion rate differences (email - paid_search):")
for seg in conv_diff.index:
    diff = conv_diff[seg]
    print(f"{seg}: {diff}")

# Within-segment average revenue differences
rev_diff = rev_by_seg.loc['email'] - rev_by_seg.loc['paid_search']
print("\nWithin-segment average revenue differences (email - paid_search):")
for seg in rev_diff.index:
    diff = rev_diff[seg]
    print(f"{seg}: {diff}")

# Print the full summary table for verification
print("\nFull summary of campaign effect by segment:")
for seg in ['loyal', 'new', 'returning']:
    email_conv = conv_by_seg.loc['email', seg]
    paid_conv = conv_by_seg.loc['paid_search', seg]
    email_rev = rev_by_seg.loc['email', seg]
    paid_rev = rev_by_seg.loc['paid_search', seg]
    conv_diff_val = email_conv - paid_conv
    rev_diff_val = email_rev - paid_rev
    print(f"{seg.capitalize()}: email conversion {email_conv:.3f} vs paid_search {paid_conv:.3f}; email revenue {email_rev:.2f} vs paid_search {paid_rev:.2f}; difference: {conv_diff_val:.3f}, {rev_diff_val:.2f}")"}
